answer: Agents could receive voting weight only after staking a scarce token that is slashed when an audited task is shown to be fraudulent. If one operator creates many fake identities, each must lock its own stake; splitting a fixed budget across them does not multiply influence, and detection can destroy the deposits. The karst ledger records claims, while a prism of independent reviewers checks evidence and quartz-secured escrow holds the stake until review. The attacker pays capital costs and risks losing it.
